local_articles.title: France put past behind them as history beckons against Spain
local_articles.snippet: DALLAS, July 12 - France are one victory from extending one of the most extraordinary eras of World Cup dominance, with a third successive final and a fifth appearance in the showpiece match in eight tournaments within reach when they face Spain on Tuesday.
